name: CodeElo
intro: CodeElo 是基于CodeForces平台的标准化竞赛级代码生成基准，旨在解决现有基准在私有测试用例、特殊裁判支持和执行环境方面的不足。该基准汇集了CodeForces上最近六个月的竞赛题目，并包含详细的比赛分区、题目难度评级和算法标签。它采用独特的Elo评分系统，通过直接向平台提交代码进行评判，从而实现与人类选手表现相当且方差更低的可靠评估。
intro_en: CodeElo is a standardized competition-level code generation benchmark based on the CodeForces platform, designed to address limitations of existing benchmarks in private test cases, special judge support, and execution environments. It aggregates contest problems from CodeForces over the past six months, including detailed contest divisions, problem difficulty ratings, and algorithm tags. Using a unique Elo rating system, it evaluates submissions by directly submitting code to the platform, achieving reliable assessments comparable to human performance with lower variance.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.01257. CodeElo is built from the official CodeForces platform. The paper gathers rated-contest problems, parses raw HTML into problem description, input/output format, examples, and notes, and preserves the original HTML format for clarity and formula structure. It attaches CodeForces metadata including contest division, problem difficulty rating, and algorithm tags, but hides tags from evaluated models. For evaluation, the model output is parsed for a code block and submitted directly to CodeForces, which avoids local execution mismatch, hidden-test leakage, and special-judge incompatibility. A solution counts only when the platform returns Accepted. The benchmark then computes a standardized Elo rating from contest rankings, comparable to human participants and lower variance than online iterative rating updates.
